brand.name: Luna
brand.niche: quiet luxury, unexplained traveling woman, composed and unaware of the camera
brand.identity_lock: Preserve Luna's exact face, freckles, hair identity, body proportions and build throughout every generation.
character_rules: never direct eye contact with camera
never smiles at or for the viewer
no CTA of any kind, never asks viewer to comment, follow, or share
never explains who she is or why she does anything
captions and on-screen text raise questions, never answer them
consistent visual signature: same black bag, low ponytail, emerald as signature color

pillars: luxury storytelling through visual lore rather than spoken exposition

trend_intelligence.current_direction: story-led luxury content: aspirational visuals plus human/lore/detail-driven narrative
principles: Luxury short-form is moving from prestige-only visuals toward narrative-led video.
Luxury discovery is increasingly creator-led and identity-driven rather than purely status-driven.
TikTok's 2026 trend framing emphasizes reality, insider detail, lore and curiosity-driven discovery over overly polished fantasy.
Small details, craft, heritage, objects and rituals can carry the story without requiring exposition.
For Luna, adapt these trends visually: mystery clues, recurring objects, unexplained access, quiet rituals and unresolved endings.

story_formulas.name: The Unexplained Arrival
story_formulas.structure: Start with Luna already entering an exclusive place; reveal one clue that implies she belongs there; end before the reason is explained.

story_formulas.name: The Object With History
story_formulas.structure: Open on a recurring luxury object or detail; connect it visually to Luna; reveal a second clue; cut before its significance is explained.

story_formulas.name: The Quiet Ritual
story_formulas.structure: Show a precise, understated luxury ritual; introduce one unusual detail; finish on the detail rather than the spectacle.

story_formulas.name: Access Without Explanation
story_formulas.structure: Show Luna moving through a place most viewers would expect restricted access to; use calm behavior and one visual clue instead of explaining it.

story_formulas.name: The Curiosity Detour
story_formulas.structure: Open on an ordinary luxury scene, introduce a strange detail, follow it for several seconds, then stop at the moment the viewer expects an answer.

story_formulas.name: The Heritage Clue
story_formulas.structure: Use architecture, craftsmanship or an old object as the first clue; place Luna inside the scene; leave the historical connection implied rather than explained.

story_formulas.name: The Wrong Detail
story_formulas.structure: Everything looks perfectly luxurious except one detail that returning viewers can recognize; never point it out directly.

story_formulas.name: The Held Stillness
story_formulas.structure: Build movement, then stop; hold on Luna or a meaningful object slightly longer than expected; cut before resolution.
